messages:
devon: :rotating_light: NA3 provisioner heartbeat is flapping hard, GPU pools showing steady drain, tail latency spiking to ~800ms for gen routes. logs show provisioner leader loop stuck on election backoff -> possible deadlock. need triage and mitigation now
ops-bot: Alert: region=na3 severity=high metric=pool_free_gpus drop >= 45% over 3m. Incident created: INC-2245
oncall-bot: Paging oncall (sanjay) for INC-2245
sanjay: On it. TL;DR: is this infra-level (node/provisioner) or runtime (batcher/kv)?
devon: Appears infra: provisioner isn't assigning new nodes. However runtime shows kvcache miss rate up and batching queue length doubled after a recent runtime deploy 2026-03-20T03:12Z. might be cascade: provisioner deadlock -> insufficient hotpool -> runtime cold starts -> batching backlog -> latency
maria: Confirming dashboards: na3 hotpool active nodes down from 120 -> 56 in last 6m. kvcache_miss_ratio for popular models jumped 18% -> 62%. per-token latency on rediskvcache path increased
sanjay: ok, steps: 1) isolate provisioner deadlock (force restart leaders) 2) emergency expand hotpool in NA1/NA2 and shift traffic 3) revert runtime change if it worsens kvcache cold starts
devon: I can force-evict provisioner pods to unblock scheduling. planning to run: 
```
kubectl -n infra delete pod -l app=gpu-provisioner --force --grace-period=0
```
jen: :thumbsup: do it, but coordinate the routing team — we should also open a quick traffic-shift window to avoid overloading NA1
alex: FYI the runtime PR (runtime#482) modified continuous-batcher prefetch threshold and reduced kvcache prewarm TTL. It shipped in the last deploy. if kvcache misses are high, reverting that PR will help cache hit-rate and stop cold starts
maria: +1 to revert if we see continued miss rate after provisioner restart. I'll patch a hotfix revert (patch branch: revert/runtime-482)
devon: evicting provisioner pods now
```
kubectl -n infra delete pod -l app=gpu-provisioner --force --grace-period=0
```
ops-bot: Detected pod deletions for label app=gpu-provisioner in infra namespace
deploy-bot: New provisioner pods starting (image: gpu-prov:v1.9.3)
sanjay: while those come back, let's shift 20% of NA3 traffic to NA1 & NA2 via routing policy to reduce pressure. routing change command: 
```
rbctl route modify --region na3 --shift 20 --targets na1,na2 --reason "provisioner-deadlock-2245"
```
jen: I've asked routing team to prep the rollout, they can flip once we confirm new pods are healthy
maria: provisioner pods are up and leader elected, but some pools still show stale allocations; running pool reconciliation job now
```
kubectl -n infra exec job/prov-reconcile -- /bin/reconcile --region na3
```
alex: I'm starting runtime revert now to rollback the prefetch/ttl change. revert PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/489

alex: Revert merged and deploy started. deploy-bot: rolling runtime change across na3 model-serving (canary 1/10)
maria: warmup job to prefill kvcache for hot models (small warmup to avoid thundering herd):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.na3.redwood/warmup?model=redwood-7b&percent=5"
```
devon: warmup kicked. also temporarily bumped kvcache TTL via feature flag to 30m (was 5m) to reduce churn
sanjay: Good. monitoring: keep an eye on kvcache_miss_ratio, batcher_queue_len, and free_gpus. Next check in 3m
ops-bot: Metric update: free_gpus restored to 92% baseline in NA3 after reconciliation and hotpool expand; latency dropped to ~210ms from 800ms
maria: kvcache_miss_ratio down to 14% after warmup + revert, batching queue normalized. Looks stable so far
jen: routing team has started rolling back the 20% diversion (rbctl route promote --region na3) now that NA3 healthy
sanjay: Nice work. We'll keep continued observation for 30m. Later actions: add leader loop watchdog to provisioner, add reconciliation frequency bump, and add canary gate for future batcher-prefetch TTL changes
devon: Filed infra postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/pm/incidents/INC-2245 (notes + timeline). Will add action items from this thread
ops-bot: Incident INC-2245 changed state to RESOLVED by sanjay
all: :tada: Thanks team
